name: v283_netprofit_median_yield_level
hypothesis: Annual net-profit consensus scaled by enterprise value may preserve the v282 net-profit direction while lowering turnover versus pure revision.

name: v283_netprofit_level_lowdisp
hypothesis: Net-profit yield should work better when analyst dispersion is low; this tests a simple level plus confidence sleeve without reverting to EPS/FCF carriers.

name: v283_netprofit_level_revision
hypothesis: Combining level and revision may lift annualized returns enough to cross Fitness while staying in the underused net-profit estimate family.
